title: M-estimation with e-statistics
summary: We present a theory of point estimation with e-statistics (e-values and e-processes) by introducing the "ME-estimator": the parameter that minimizes the corresponding e-statistic, or the evidence against it. Our approach is based on the intuitive idea of e-statistics as a measure of evidence and betting pay-off, and naturally generalizes the classical method of maximum likelihood estimation.
